learning_outcomes.text: Identifies, defines, formulates and solves the main problems related to the field.
Selects and uses the technical tools required for maintenance practices in the field.
Independently carries out a comprehensive advanced study in the field of care.
Works independently on problems related to the field.
Knows computer simulation and applications of control systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Automatic Control: System, control and automatic control; variable types (input-output, control, disturbance variables)
Control loop and its components; Advantages and disadvantages of open-loop control and closed-loop control, open-loop and closed-loop.
Reference signal types: (unit) pulse, step and ramp functions; Control System Responses: Transient response, steady state response, and steady state error.
Inverse Laplace Transform and method of partial fractions - sample problem solutions.1
Inverse Laplace Transform and method of partial fractions - sample problem solutions.2
Mathematical Modeling of Dynamical Systems: Mechanical and electrical systems; Transfer function.1
Mathematical Modeling of Dynamical Systems: Mechanical and electrical systems; Transfer function.2
Block diagram representation: Series, parallel and feedback connection; simplification of block diagrams.
Block diagram representation: Series, parallel and feedback connection; simplification of block diagrams.
Controller Types: P, I, D, PI, PD and PID controllers
Controller Types: P, I, D, PI, PD and PID controllers
Stability of control systems: Routh-Hurwitz Criterion.
Computer simulation and applications of control systems
